evals.prompt: Our CI takes 40 minutes. Speed it up.
evals.expected_output: Asks for/reads real timings, then applies the perf playbook: concurrency cancel-in-progress, per-job timeout-minutes, lockfile-keyed caches, splitting fast lint from slow integration, and matrix tuning. Reports before/after and avoids larger runners unless measured.

evals.prompt: We repeat the same 60-line setup in 5 workflows. Deduplicate it.
evals.expected_output: Applies the extraction ladder: extracts a local composite action (or reusable workflow if jobs are duplicated), updates all callers, and deletes the duplicated predecessor rather than stacking both shapes. Explains why the chosen rung is minimal.
